# Erwin Mongui

> Erwin Mongui is a software engineering leader based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. He is the Director of Technology and Software Engineering Manager at Cedar Planters in Oakville, Ontario, and a Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Lambton College, 2024). He has 18+ years of experience (since 2010) building customer-facing platforms, owning architecture end to end, and leading engineering teams.

Canonical profile: https://erwinmongui.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/erwin-mongui/
Contact: https://erwinmongui.com/#contact (email and LinkedIn buttons)

## Current role

- Director of Technology and Software Engineering Manager, Cedar Planters, Oakville, Ontario (January 2024 to present). Cedar Planters is a Canadian e-commerce company that makes modular planters.
- Joined as the first technical hire and built the technology department from zero: CI/CD, security practices, Agile workflows and a team of three.
- Built the company's data platform, replacing third-party reporting tools and spreadsheets with central, standard reporting. The time to produce a new report fell from months to days, and to hours with AI-assisted development and analysis.
- Leads cross-functional teams building scalable applications and owns the full lifecycle from requirements to deployment.
- Redesigned the data models behind analytical and operational workloads, making retrieval and analysis 20% faster.
- Runs continuous website improvement through A/B testing and third-party API integrations, and keeps tracking, security and dependencies current.

## Earlier roles

- CTO and Software Engineering Team Lead, Fincaraiz.com.co (Adevinta group), Bogotá, Colombia, May 2019 to November 2022. Led a team of 30 through the migration of a legacy ASP.NET monolith to Django and React microservices on Kubernetes, using the strangler fig pattern in four tiers (platform; Kong API gateway and Keycloak identity; PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch data with AWS Lambda sync; domain services), for a real estate portal with 5M+ monthly visits and zero downtime. The migration cut hosting and maintenance costs by 50% and rebuilt search with natural language understanding and geographic polygons that resolve local neighbourhood nicknames to official boundaries; launched 15+ REST APIs on a Python and Django microservice backend, reducing latency by 25%; built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; hired and grew backend and platform engineers.
- Software Architect for Fincaraiz's B2B lead distribution system (2021): a central engine with GraphQL, retries with exponential backoff and a configurable Connector service that delivers buyer leads to the CRMs of real estate agencies and property developers (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Microsoft Dynamics and custom CRMs), with 100% data parity and partner onboarding in minutes instead of weeks.
- Lead Software Engineer, Fincaraiz.com.co, Bogotá, July 2015 to July 2018. Led the rebuild of the core customer-facing website (+25% user engagement), automated 70% of manual operational work, introduced Docker and Kubernetes and Agile practices.
- Senior Software Engineer, Periferia IT, Bogotá, May 2013 to June 2015. Consulted for Old Mutual (payment microservice on .NET MVC, +50% sales in year one) and Editorial Legis (ASP.NET REST APIs, +40% content management efficiency).
- Junior Software Engineer, Americas BPS for Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Bogotá, February 2010 to June 2012. C# and .NET applications.

## Education and credentials

- Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Lambton College, Toronto, August 2024.
- Bachelor of Computer Engineering, Fundación Universitaria Los Libertadores, Bogotá, October 2013.
- Scrum Master Certified (SMC), SCRUMstudy, 2016.
- Continuing education certificates in machine learning, NLP, software architecture, microservices, REST API design, Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, Amazon S3, Django with GraphQL, and fintech (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, Refactoring.Guru), 2021 to 2024.

## Expertise

- Engineering leadership: technical strategy, architecture ownership, hiring and onboarding, mentorship, performance management, technical debt roadmaps, metrics-driven prioritization.
- Backend and architecture: Python, Django, Django-Celery, C#, .NET, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices, RabbitMQ.
- Machine learning and AI: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib; AI-assisted development with Cursor and Windsurf.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Spinnaker, CI/CD.
- Data and search: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr, Apache NiFi.
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, A/B testing, web performance.

## Recognition

- Adevinta Culture Awards 2019 finalist, while CTO at Fincaraiz.com.co.

## Languages

- Spanish (native), English (proficient).

## Research

- Co-author, "Eliminating Randomness in Selecting International Passengers for RT-PCR" (Umid Ghimire, Dharmik Limbani, Erwin Mongui, Sairam Kilari; Lambton College), STEM Fellowship Big Data and AI Challenge 2023, published in the STEM Fellowship Journal proceedings, doi:10.17975/sfj-2023-007. The study used WHO and Government of Canada COVID-19 data and traveller RT-PCR reports to replace random selection at Toronto Pearson International Airport with priority groups.

## Case studies

- [Monolith to microservices, without stopping a 5M-visit platform](https://erwinmongui.com/work/fincaraiz-monolith-to-microservices/): How Erwin Mongui moved Fincaraiz from ASP.NET to Django, React and Kubernetes for 5M+ monthly visits: zero downtime, 50% lower costs and NLP search.
- [A lead distribution engine that connects to any CRM](https://erwinmongui.com/work/fincaraiz-lead-distribution/): How Erwin Mongui designed Fincaraiz's B2B lead distribution: GraphQL, fault-tolerant retries, 100% data parity and a Connector service for six CRM platforms.
- [A data platform from zero, as the first technical hire](https://erwinmongui.com/work/cedar-planters-data-platform/): As Cedar Planters' first technical hire, Erwin Mongui replaced third-party reporting tools with one data platform. New reports went from months to hours.

## Writing

- [Finding delivery bottlenecks with lead time and cycle time](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/lead-time-cycle-time-bottlenecks/): A five-step way to find where software work gets stuck using lead time, cycle time and flow metrics, confirm the cause with the team, and fix it.
- [How I measure engineering team health](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/engineering-team-health-metrics/): The delivery, health and impact metrics I track, how they map to DORA and SPACE, and how to tell whether AI coding assistants are really helping a team.
- [From data analyst to data engineer, through one good question](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/from-data-analyst-to-data-engineer/): How asking a data analyst to challenge our pipeline tool led to a better stack and a new data engineer. A guided discovery approach to mentoring, with AI.
- [Pick the tool your team can support, not the one on the shortlist](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/choose-tools-your-team-can-support/): A single sign-on project took six times longer than planned. What went wrong, the tool-selection scorecard we use now, and how AI assistants change it.
- [Shaping the future: what new graduates need for a career in AI](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/ai-careers-new-graduates/): An engineering manager's view of AI careers for new graduates: collaboration, real projects, AI-assisted development, evaluation, ethics and frameworks.
- [Taming the data jungle: JSON as the contract between your systems and AI](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/ai-applications-json/): Why JSON became the contract between software and AI models: structured outputs with JSON Schema and Pydantic, tool calling, MCP, memory and model configs.
- [Replacing random RT-PCR checks with data-driven traveller selection](https://erwinmongui.com/writing/rt-pcr-travel-screening-data-driven-selection/): Our STEM Fellowship Big Data and AI Challenge 2023 paper: using WHO and Government of Canada data to prioritize travellers for RT-PCR checks instead of at random.

- [Cómo mido la salud de un equipo de ingeniería](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/metricas-de-salud-de-equipos-de-ingenieria/): Las métricas de entrega, salud e impacto que sigo, cómo se relacionan con DORA y SPACE, y cómo saber si los asistentes de IA realmente ayudan a un equipo.
- [De analista de datos a ingeniero de datos, gracias a una buena pregunta](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/de-analista-de-datos-a-ingeniero-de-datos/): Cómo pedirle a un analista que cuestionara nuestra herramienta de pipelines llevó a un mejor stack y a un nuevo ingeniero de datos. Descubrimiento guiado, con IA.
- [Elige la herramienta que tu equipo puede sostener, no la que encabeza la lista](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/elegir-herramientas-que-tu-equipo-pueda-sostener/): Un proyecto de inicio de sesión único tomó seis veces más de lo planeado. Qué salió mal, la matriz de evaluación que usamos y cómo cambia la decisión con IA.
- [Construir el futuro: lo que necesitan los recién graduados para una carrera en IA](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/carreras-en-ia-para-recien-graduados/): La visión de un líder de ingeniería sobre carreras en IA: colaboración, proyectos reales, desarrollo asistido por IA, evaluación, ética y frameworks.
- [Domar la jungla de datos: JSON como contrato entre tus sistemas y la IA](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/json-en-aplicaciones-de-ia/): Por qué JSON se volvió el contrato entre el software y los modelos de IA: salidas estructuradas con JSON Schema y Pydantic, herramientas, MCP y memoria.
- [Reemplazar la selección aleatoria para RT-PCR con una selección de viajeros basada en datos](https://erwinmongui.com/es/articulos/seleccion-de-viajeros-rt-pcr-basada-en-datos/): Nuestro artículo del STEM Fellowship Big Data and AI Challenge 2023: datos de la OMS y del Gobierno de Canadá para priorizar viajeros para RT-PCR.
